lines.beaver_en: How was the reunion yesterday? Did everyone come?
lines.learner: 응, 동창들 거의 다 왔어. 정말 반가웠어.
lines.en: Yeah, almost all our classmates came. It was so good to see them.
lines.roman: Eung, dongchangdeul geoui da wasseo. Jeongmal bangawosseo.

lines.beaver: 와, 부럽다. 감기만 아니었으면 갔을 텐데.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, I'm jealous. I'd have gone if I didn't have a cold.
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, bureopda. Gamgiman anieosseumyeon gasseul tende.
lines.learner: 민수가 케이크를 사 와서 다 같이 먹었어.
lines.en: Minsu brought a cake, and we all ate it together.
lines.roman: Minsuga keikeureul sa waseo da gachi meogeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Minsu? I heard he's famous these days.
lines.en: Yeah, I heard he got famous as a chef. But he hasn't changed.

lines.beaver_en: What about Jieun and Hana? They used to fight a lot.
lines.en: Now the two of them get along really well.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. So their friendship survived.
lines.learner: 응. 지은이가 하나를 많이 격려해 줬대.
lines.en: Yeah. I heard Jieun encouraged Hana a lot.
lines.roman: Eung. Jieuniga hanareul mani gyeongnyeohae jwotdae.

lines.beaver_en: Did our homeroom teacher come too?
lines.learner: 응. 선생님 은혜 얘기하면서 다들 울었어.
lines.en: Yes. We all cried talking about how kind the teacher was to us.
lines.roman: Eung. Seonsaengnim eunhye yaegihamyeonseo dadeul ureosseo.

lines.beaver_en: I want to see the teacher too.
lines.en: The teacher said to take good care of yourself.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. It's nice to hear the news.
lines.learner: 우리 인연이 벌써 십 년이 넘었더라.
lines.en: Our bond has already lasted over ten years.
lines.roman: Uri inyeoni beolsseo sim nyeoni neomeotdeora.

lines.learner: 난 너한테 신세를 많이 져서 늘 고마워.
lines.en: I owe you a lot, so I'm always grateful.
lines.roman: Nan neohante sinsereul mani jyeoseo neul gomawo.

lines.beaver_en: What are you saying? It's the same for me.
lines.learner: 네 기념품도 받아다 놨어. 내일 갖다줄게.
lines.en: I picked up your souvenir too. I'll bring it tomorrow.
lines.roman: Ne ginyeompumdo badada nwasseo. Naeil gatdajulge.
